#!/bin/bash
# Mac Mini M4 Pro - Local AI Video Production Auto-Setup
# Complete installation script for ComfyUI + Ollama + Audio Tools
#
# Usage: bash mac-m4-pro-ai-setup.sh [24|48|64]
# Example: bash mac-m4-pro-ai-setup.sh 48  # For 48GB RAM

set -e  # Exit on error

# Colors for output
RED='\033[0;31m'
GREEN='\033[0;32m'
YELLOW='\033[1;33m'
BLUE='\033[0;34m'
NC='\033[0m' # No Color

# Configuration
RAM_SIZE="${1:-48}"  # Default to 48GB if not specified
INSTALL_DIR="$HOME/Applications"
COMFYUI_DIR="$INSTALL_DIR/ComfyUI"
AUDIO_DIR="$INSTALL_DIR/ai-audio-tools"
PYTHON_VERSION="3.11"

echo -e "${BLUE}================================================${NC}"
echo -e "${BLUE}  Mac M4 Pro AI Video Production Setup${NC}"
echo -e "${BLUE}  RAM Configuration: ${RAM_SIZE}GB${NC}"
echo -e "${BLUE}================================================${NC}"
echo ""

# Function to print status messages
print_status() {
    echo -e "${GREEN}[✓]${NC} $1"
}

print_error() {
    echo -e "${RED}[✗]${NC} $1"
}

print_warning() {
    echo -e "${YELLOW}[!]${NC} $1"
}

print_info() {
    echo -e "${BLUE}[i]${NC} $1"
}

# Check if running on macOS
if [[ "$(uname)" != "Darwin" ]]; then
    print_error "This script is for macOS only!"
    exit 1
fi

# Check if Apple Silicon
if [[ "$(uname -m)" != "arm64" ]]; then
    print_error "This script requires Apple Silicon (M1/M2/M3/M4)!"
    exit 1
fi

# Validate RAM size
if [[ ! "$RAM_SIZE" =~ ^(24|48|64)$ ]]; then
    print_error "Invalid RAM size. Use: 24, 48, or 64"
    exit 1
fi

# ============================================================================
# DISK SPACE CHECK
# ============================================================================

print_info "Checking available disk space..."
AVAILABLE_GB=$(df -g "$HOME" | awk 'NR==2 {print $4}')
REQUIRED_GB=60

if [[ "$AVAILABLE_GB" -lt "$REQUIRED_GB" ]]; then
    print_error "Not enough disk space! Need at least ${REQUIRED_GB}GB, have ${AVAILABLE_GB}GB"
    print_info "Free up space and try again."
    exit 1
fi
print_status "Disk space OK (${AVAILABLE_GB}GB available, need ~${REQUIRED_GB}GB)"

# Select LLM model based on RAM
case $RAM_SIZE in
    24)
        PRIMARY_MODEL="qwen2.5:14b"
        SECONDARY_MODEL="gemma2:9b"
        ;;
    48)
        PRIMARY_MODEL="qwen2.5:72b"
        SECONDARY_MODEL="deepseek-r1:70b"
        ;;
    64)
        PRIMARY_MODEL="qwen2.5:72b"
        SECONDARY_MODEL="deepseek-r1:70b"
        TERTIARY_MODEL="llama3.3:70b"
        ;;
esac

echo ""
print_info "Starting installation..."
echo ""

# ============================================================================
# PART 1: Install Homebrew (if not installed)
# ============================================================================

echo -e "${BLUE}[1/7] Checking Homebrew...${NC}"

if ! command -v brew &> /dev/null; then
    print_warning "Homebrew not found. Installing..."
    /bin/bash -c "$(curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Homebrew/install/HEAD/install.sh)"

    # Add Homebrew to PATH for Apple Silicon
    if [[ -f "/opt/homebrew/bin/brew" ]]; then
        echo 'eval "$(/opt/homebrew/bin/brew shellenv)"' >> ~/.zprofile
        eval "$(/opt/homebrew/bin/brew shellenv)"
    fi

    print_status "Homebrew installed"
else
    print_status "Homebrew already installed"
fi

# Update Homebrew
print_info "Updating Homebrew..."
brew update 2>&1 | tail -1
print_status "Homebrew updated"

echo ""

# ============================================================================
# PART 2: Install System Dependencies
# ============================================================================

echo -e "${BLUE}[2/7] Installing system dependencies...${NC}"

# Install Python 3.11
if ! command -v python3.11 &> /dev/null; then
    print_info "Installing Python 3.11..."
    brew install python@3.11
    print_status "Python 3.11 installed"
else
    print_status "Python 3.11 already installed"
fi

# Install Git (usually pre-installed, but check)
if ! command -v git &> /dev/null; then
    print_info "Installing Git..."
    brew install git
    print_status "Git installed"
else
    print_status "Git already installed"
fi

# Install wget (useful for downloads)
if ! command -v wget &> /dev/null; then
    print_info "Installing wget..."
    brew install wget
    print_status "wget installed"
else
    print_status "wget already installed"
fi

# Install jq (JSON processor)
if ! command -v jq &> /dev/null; then
    print_info "Installing jq..."
    brew install jq
    print_status "jq installed"
else
    print_status "jq already installed"
fi

# Install ffmpeg (for audio/video processing)
if ! command -v ffmpeg &> /dev/null; then
    print_info "Installing ffmpeg..."
    brew install ffmpeg
    print_status "ffmpeg installed"
else
    print_status "ffmpeg already installed"
fi

# Install pkg-config (required for building PyAV/AudioCraft)
if ! command -v pkg-config &> /dev/null; then
    print_info "Installing pkg-config..."
    brew install pkg-config
    print_status "pkg-config installed"
else
    print_status "pkg-config already installed"
fi

echo ""

# ============================================================================
# PART 3: Install Ollama
# ============================================================================

echo -e "${BLUE}[3/7] Installing Ollama...${NC}"

if ! command -v ollama &> /dev/null; then
    print_info "Installing Ollama..."
    brew install ollama
    print_status "Ollama installed"
else
    print_status "Ollama already installed"
fi

# Start Ollama service
print_info "Starting Ollama service..."
brew services start ollama > /dev/null 2>&1 || true
sleep 3
print_status "Ollama service started"

echo ""

# ============================================================================
# PART 4: Download LLM Models (sequential)
# ============================================================================

echo -e "${BLUE}[4/7] Downloading LLM models (this may take 10-30 minutes)...${NC}"

print_info "Downloading primary model: $PRIMARY_MODEL"
ollama pull "$PRIMARY_MODEL"
print_status "$PRIMARY_MODEL downloaded"

print_info "Downloading secondary model: $SECONDARY_MODEL"
ollama pull "$SECONDARY_MODEL"
print_status "$SECONDARY_MODEL downloaded"

if [[ -n "$TERTIARY_MODEL" ]]; then
    print_info "Downloading tertiary model: $TERTIARY_MODEL"
    ollama pull "$TERTIARY_MODEL"
    print_status "$TERTIARY_MODEL downloaded"
fi

print_status "All LLM models downloaded"

echo ""

# ============================================================================
# PART 5: Install ComfyUI
# ============================================================================

echo -e "${BLUE}[5/7] Installing ComfyUI...${NC}"

# Create Applications directory
mkdir -p "$INSTALL_DIR"

if [[ -d "$COMFYUI_DIR" ]]; then
    print_warning "ComfyUI directory already exists. Updating..."
    cd "$COMFYUI_DIR"
    git pull || true
else
    print_info "Cloning ComfyUI repository..."
    cd "$INSTALL_DIR"
    git clone https://github.com/comfyanonymous/ComfyUI.git
    cd "$COMFYUI_DIR"
fi

print_status "ComfyUI repository ready"

# Create virtual environment
if [[ ! -d "$COMFYUI_DIR/venv" ]]; then
    print_info "Creating Python virtual environment..."
    python3.11 -m venv venv
    print_status "Virtual environment created"
else
    print_status "Virtual environment already exists"
fi

# Activate virtual environment and install dependencies
print_info "Installing ComfyUI dependencies (this may take 5-10 minutes)..."
source venv/bin/activate

# Install PyTorch with MPS support for Apple Silicon
pip install --upgrade pip 2>&1 | tail -1
print_info "Installing PyTorch..."
pip install torch torchvision torchaudio 2>&1 | tail -3

# Install ComfyUI requirements
print_info "Installing ComfyUI requirements..."
pip install -r requirements.txt 2>&1 | tail -3

deactivate
print_status "ComfyUI dependencies installed"

# Install ComfyUI Manager
if [[ ! -d "$COMFYUI_DIR/custom_nodes/ComfyUI-Manager" ]]; then
    print_info "Installing ComfyUI Manager..."
    mkdir -p custom_nodes
    cd custom_nodes
    git clone https://github.com/ltdrdata/ComfyUI-Manager.git
    cd ..
    print_status "ComfyUI Manager installed"
else
    print_status "ComfyUI Manager already installed"
fi

echo ""

# ============================================================================
# PART 6: Install Audio Tools (separate venv)
# ============================================================================

echo -e "${BLUE}[6/7] Installing audio tools (separate environment)...${NC}"

mkdir -p "$AUDIO_DIR"

if [[ ! -d "$AUDIO_DIR/venv" ]]; then
    print_info "Creating audio tools virtual environment..."
    python3.11 -m venv "$AUDIO_DIR/venv"
    print_status "Audio venv created"
else
    print_status "Audio venv already exists"
fi

source "$AUDIO_DIR/venv/bin/activate"
pip install --upgrade pip 2>&1 | tail -1

# Install Piper TTS (lightweight fallback)
print_info "Installing Piper TTS..."
pip install piper-tts pathvalidate 2>&1 | tail -3
print_status "Piper TTS installed"

# Install Coqui TTS (high-quality VITS multi-speaker, primary TTS)
print_info "Installing espeak-ng (phonemizer backend for Coqui TTS)..."
brew install espeak-ng 2>&1 | tail -3
print_info "Installing Coqui TTS..."
pip install TTS 2>&1 | tail -3
print_status "Coqui TTS installed"

# Download a default Piper voice model
PIPER_VOICES_DIR="$AUDIO_DIR/piper-voices"
mkdir -p "$PIPER_VOICES_DIR"
if [[ ! -f "$PIPER_VOICES_DIR/en_US-lessac-medium.onnx" ]]; then
    print_info "Downloading Piper voice model (en_US-lessac-medium)..."
    wget -q -O "$PIPER_VOICES_DIR/en_US-lessac-medium.onnx" \
        "https://huggingface.co/rhasspy/piper-voices/resolve/v1.0.0/en/en_US/lessac/medium/en_US-lessac-medium.onnx"
    wget -q -O "$PIPER_VOICES_DIR/en_US-lessac-medium.onnx.json" \
        "https://huggingface.co/rhasspy/piper-voices/resolve/v1.0.0/en/en_US/lessac/medium/en_US-lessac-medium.onnx.json"
    print_status "Piper voice model downloaded"
else
    print_status "Piper voice model already exists"
fi

# Install PyTorch in audio venv (required for AudioCraft build)
print_info "Installing PyTorch for audio tools..."
pip install torch torchvision torchaudio 2>&1 | tail -3

# Install AudioCraft (MusicGen)
# AudioCraft requires xformers which doesn't compile on macOS ARM,
# so we install without deps, add runtime deps manually, and patch xformers import
print_info "Installing AudioCraft (MusicGen)..."
pip install audiocraft --no-deps 2>&1 | tail -3
pip install einops flashy num2words encodec demucs soundfile spacy librosa sentencepiece 2>&1 | tail -3

# Patch xformers imports to optional (xformers doesn't build on macOS ARM)
TRANSFORMER_FILE="$AUDIO_DIR/venv/lib/python3.11/site-packages/audiocraft/modules/transformer.py"
if [[ -f "$TRANSFORMER_FILE" ]]; then
    print_info "Patching AudioCraft for macOS ARM (xformers → optional)..."
    # 1. Make top-level xformers import optional
    if grep -q "^from xformers import ops$" "$TRANSFORMER_FILE"; then
        sed -i '' 's/^from xformers import ops$/try:\
    from xformers import ops\
except ImportError:\
    ops = None/' "$TRANSFORMER_FILE"
    fi
    # 2. Make _verify_xformers_memory_efficient_compat a no-op when xformers missing
    sed -i '' '/^def _verify_xformers_memory_efficient_compat/,/pip install.*xformers/ {
        s/raise ImportError(/pass  # xformers not available on macOS ARM/
    }' "$TRANSFORMER_FILE"
    # 3. Disable memory_efficient when xformers (ops) is None
    sed -i '' 's/self.memory_efficient = memory_efficient/if memory_efficient and ops is None:\
            memory_efficient = False\
        self.memory_efficient = memory_efficient/' "$TRANSFORMER_FILE"
    print_status "AudioCraft patched"
fi
print_status "AudioCraft installed"

# Install WhisperX (speech-to-text)
print_info "Installing WhisperX..."
if pip install whisperx 2>&1 | tail -3; then
    print_status "WhisperX installed"
else
    print_warning "WhisperX installation failed (optional, continuing...)"
fi

deactivate

echo ""

# ============================================================================
# PART 7: Create Helper Scripts
# ============================================================================

echo -e "${BLUE}[7/7] Creating helper scripts...${NC}"

# Save model config for use by helper scripts
mkdir -p "$HOME/.config/tinyclaw"
cat > "$HOME/.config/tinyclaw/ai-config.sh" << EOFCONFIG
# Auto-generated by mac-m4-pro-ai-setup.sh
RAM_SIZE=$RAM_SIZE
PRIMARY_MODEL=$PRIMARY_MODEL
SECONDARY_MODEL=$SECONDARY_MODEL
TERTIARY_MODEL=${TERTIARY_MODEL:-}
COMFYUI_DIR=$COMFYUI_DIR
AUDIO_DIR=$AUDIO_DIR
PIPER_VOICES_DIR=$PIPER_VOICES_DIR
TTS_SPEAKER=p273
EOFCONFIG
print_status "Saved AI config to ~/.config/tinyclaw/ai-config.sh"

# Create start script for ComfyUI
cat > "$HOME/start-comfyui.sh" << 'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
cd ~/Applications/ComfyUI
source venv/bin/activate
python main.py
EOF

chmod +x "$HOME/start-comfyui.sh"
print_status "Created start-comfyui.sh"

# Create video workflow script
cat > "$HOME/ai-video-workflow.sh" << 'EOFWORKFLOW'
#!/bin/bash
# AI Video Production Workflow
# Usage: ./ai-video-workflow.sh "Your video topic"

# Load config
if [[ -f "$HOME/.config/tinyclaw/ai-config.sh" ]]; then
    source "$HOME/.config/tinyclaw/ai-config.sh"
else
    echo "Error: AI config not found. Run mac-m4-pro-ai-setup.sh first."
    exit 1
fi

if [[ -z "$1" ]]; then
    echo "Usage: $0 'Video topic'"
    exit 1
fi

TOPIC="$1"
OUTPUT_DIR="$HOME/Videos/AI-Generated/$(date +%Y%m%d_%H%M%S)"
mkdir -p "$OUTPUT_DIR"

echo "================================================"
echo "  AI Video Production Pipeline"
echo "  Topic: $TOPIC"
echo "  Model: $PRIMARY_MODEL"
echo "  Output: $OUTPUT_DIR"
echo "================================================"
echo ""

# Step 1: Generate Script
echo "[1/5] Generating video script..."
SCRIPT=$(ollama run "$PRIMARY_MODEL" "Write a YouTube video narrator script about: $TOPIC.

IMPORTANT RULES:
- Write ONLY the spoken narration text, exactly as a narrator would read it aloud.
- Do NOT use any markdown formatting (no **, no #, no -, no bullets, no numbered lists).
- Do NOT include URLs, links, or file paths in the narration.
- Do NOT include stage directions like [cut to], [on-screen text], or [music].
- Use natural paragraph breaks between sections.
- Duration: 8-10 minutes of spoken content.
- Start with an engaging hook, cover the main points conversationally, end with a call-to-action.
- When mentioning terminal commands, describe what they do instead of reading them verbatim.")
echo "$SCRIPT" > "$OUTPUT_DIR/script.txt"
echo "✓ Script saved to script.txt"
echo ""

# Step 2: Generate Shot List
echo "[2/5] Creating shot list..."
SHOTLIST=$(ollama run "$PRIMARY_MODEL" "Convert this narration script into a detailed shot list for AI video generation. For the shot list you MAY use markdown formatting, timestamps, and technical directions:

$SCRIPT")
echo "$SHOTLIST" > "$OUTPUT_DIR/shotlist.txt"
echo "✓ Shot list saved to shotlist.txt"
echo ""

# Step 3: Clean script for TTS and generate voiceover
echo "[3/5] Generating voiceover..."
source "$AUDIO_DIR/venv/bin/activate"

# Clean the script text for TTS: strip any remaining markdown, URLs, special chars
python3 -c "
import re, sys
text = open('$OUTPUT_DIR/script.txt').read()
# Remove markdown bold/italic
text = re.sub(r'\*{1,3}([^*]+)\*{1,3}', r'\1', text)
# Remove markdown headers
text = re.sub(r'^#{1,6}\s*', '', text, flags=re.MULTILINE)
# Remove markdown links [text](url) -> text
text = re.sub(r'\[([^\]]+)\]\([^)]+\)', r'\1', text)
# Remove bare URLs
text = re.sub(r'https?://\S+', '', text)
# Remove backtick code
text = re.sub(r'\`[^\`]+\`', '', text)
# Remove bullet markers
text = re.sub(r'^[\s]*[-•]\s*', '', text, flags=re.MULTILINE)
# Remove numbered list markers
text = re.sub(r'^[\s]*\d+\.\s*', '', text, flags=re.MULTILINE)
# Remove stage directions [anything in brackets]
text = re.sub(r'\[[^\]]*\]', '', text)
# Clean up multiple blank lines
text = re.sub(r'\n{3,}', '\n\n', text)
# Remove lines that are only whitespace
text = re.sub(r'^\s+$', '', text, flags=re.MULTILINE)
open('$OUTPUT_DIR/voiceover_text.txt', 'w').write(text.strip())
print(f'Cleaned: {len(text.strip())} chars')
" 2>&1

# Try Coqui VITS (better quality), fall back to Piper
if python3 -c "from TTS.api import TTS" 2>/dev/null; then
    echo "  Using Coqui VITS (high quality)..."
    TTS_SPEAKER="\${TTS_SPEAKER:-p273}"
    python3 -c "
from TTS.api import TTS
tts = TTS('tts_models/en/vctk/vits', gpu=False)
tts.tts_to_file(
    text=open('$OUTPUT_DIR/voiceover_text.txt').read(),
    speaker='$TTS_SPEAKER',
    file_path='$OUTPUT_DIR/voiceover.wav'
)
print('Generated with Coqui VITS')
" 2>&1
else
    echo "  Using Piper TTS (fallback)..."
    cat "$OUTPUT_DIR/voiceover_text.txt" | piper \
        --model "$PIPER_VOICES_DIR/en_US-lessac-medium.onnx" \
        --output_file "$OUTPUT_DIR/voiceover.wav"
fi
echo "✓ Voiceover saved to voiceover.wav"
echo ""

# Step 4: Generate Background Music
echo "[4/5] Generating background music..."
OUTPUT_PATH="$OUTPUT_DIR/music.wav"
python3 -c "
from audiocraft.models import MusicGen
import torchaudio

model = MusicGen.get_pretrained('facebook/musicgen-medium')
model.set_generation_params(duration=60)
wav = model.generate(['upbeat youtube background music'])
torchaudio.save('$OUTPUT_PATH', wav[0].cpu(), model.sample_rate)
"
echo "✓ Music saved to music.wav"
echo ""

# Step 5: Assemble Video
echo "[5/5] Assembling video with transitions..."
SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)"
BUILD_VIDEO="${SCRIPT_DIR}/build-video.py"
if [[ ! -f "$BUILD_VIDEO" ]]; then
    BUILD_VIDEO="$HOME/build-video.py"
fi
if [[ -f "$BUILD_VIDEO" ]]; then
    python3 "$BUILD_VIDEO" "$OUTPUT_DIR"
else
    echo "  Warning: build-video.py not found, skipping video assembly"
fi
deactivate
echo ""

echo "================================================"
echo "  Video Production Complete!"
echo "================================================"
echo ""
echo "Files location: $OUTPUT_DIR"
echo ""
echo "Optional next steps:"
echo "1. Start ComfyUI for AI video clips: ~/start-comfyui.sh"
echo "2. Edit in DaVinci Resolve"
EOFWORKFLOW

chmod +x "$HOME/ai-video-workflow.sh"
print_status "Created ai-video-workflow.sh"

# Copy video assembler script
SETUP_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)"
if [[ -f "$SETUP_DIR/build-video.py" ]]; then
    cp "$SETUP_DIR/build-video.py" "$HOME/build-video.py"
    chmod +x "$HOME/build-video.py"
    print_status "Copied build-video.py"
else
    print_warning "build-video.py not found in setup directory"
fi

# Create quick test script
cat > "$HOME/test-ai-setup.sh" << 'EOFTEST'
#!/bin/bash
echo "================================================"
echo "  Testing AI Setup"
echo "================================================"
echo ""

# Load config
if [[ -f "$HOME/.config/tinyclaw/ai-config.sh" ]]; then
    source "$HOME/.config/tinyclaw/ai-config.sh"
    echo "Config: RAM=${RAM_SIZE}GB, Model=${PRIMARY_MODEL}"
    echo ""
else
    echo "Warning: No config found at ~/.config/tinyclaw/ai-config.sh"
    echo ""
fi

PASS=0
FAIL=0

# Test Ollama
echo "[1/5] Testing Ollama..."
if command -v ollama &> /dev/null; then
    MODEL_COUNT=$(ollama list 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' ')
    echo "✓ Ollama is installed ($MODEL_COUNT models)"
    ollama list 2>/dev/null
    ((PASS++))
else
    echo "✗ Ollama not found"
    ((FAIL++))
fi
echo ""

# Test ComfyUI
echo "[2/5] Testing ComfyUI..."
if [[ -f ~/Applications/ComfyUI/main.py ]]; then
    echo "✓ ComfyUI is installed"
    ((PASS++))
else
    echo "✗ ComfyUI not found"
    ((FAIL++))
fi
if [[ -d ~/Applications/ComfyUI/custom_nodes/ComfyUI-Manager ]]; then
    echo "✓ ComfyUI Manager is installed"
else
    echo "✗ ComfyUI Manager not found"
fi
echo ""

# Test Audio Tools
echo "[3/5] Testing audio tools..."
AUDIO_VENV="${AUDIO_DIR:-$HOME/Applications/ai-audio-tools}/venv"
if [[ -d "$AUDIO_VENV" ]]; then
    source "$AUDIO_VENV/bin/activate"

    if python3 -c "from TTS.api import TTS" 2>/dev/null; then
        echo "✓ Coqui TTS (VITS) is installed"
        ((PASS++))
    elif command -v piper &> /dev/null; then
        echo "✓ Piper TTS is installed (Coqui TTS not available)"
        ((PASS++))
    else
        echo "✗ TTS engine not found"
        ((FAIL++))
    fi

    if python3 -c "import audiocraft" 2>/dev/null; then
        echo "✓ AudioCraft (MusicGen) is installed"
        ((PASS++))
    else
        echo "✗ AudioCraft not found"
        ((FAIL++))
    fi

    if python3 -c "import whisperx" 2>/dev/null; then
        echo "✓ WhisperX is installed"
    else
        echo "- WhisperX not installed (optional)"
    fi

    deactivate
else
    echo "✗ Audio tools venv not found at $AUDIO_VENV"
    ((FAIL++))
fi
echo ""

# Test Piper voice model
echo "[4/5] Testing voice models..."
VOICES_DIR="${PIPER_VOICES_DIR:-$HOME/Applications/ai-audio-tools/piper-voices}"
if [[ -f "$VOICES_DIR/en_US-lessac-medium.onnx" ]]; then
    echo "✓ Piper voice model found"
    ((PASS++))
else
    echo "✗ Piper voice model not found"
    ((FAIL++))
fi
echo ""

echo "================================================"
echo "  Results: $PASS passed, $FAIL failed"
echo "================================================"
if [[ $FAIL -eq 0 ]]; then
    echo "  All checks passed! Ready to go."
else
    echo "  Some checks failed. Re-run setup or check above."
fi
EOFTEST

chmod +x "$HOME/test-ai-setup.sh"
print_status "Created test-ai-setup.sh"

echo ""

# ============================================================================
# INSTALLATION COMPLETE
# ============================================================================

echo ""
echo -e "${GREEN}================================================${NC}"
echo -e "${GREEN}  Installation Complete!${NC}"
echo -e "${GREEN}================================================${NC}"
echo ""
print_info "Setup Summary:"
echo "  • ComfyUI: $COMFYUI_DIR"
echo "  • Audio Tools: $AUDIO_DIR (separate venv)"
echo "  • Ollama: $(which ollama)"
echo "  • LLM Models: $(ollama list 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' ') models"
echo "  • TTS Engine: Coqui VITS (primary) + Piper TTS (fallback)"
echo "  • RAM Config: ${RAM_SIZE}GB"
echo ""
print_info "Quick Start Commands:"
echo ""
echo "  1. Start ComfyUI:"
echo "     ~/start-comfyui.sh"
echo "     Open: http://127.0.0.1:8188"
echo ""
echo "  2. Test Ollama:"
echo "     ollama run $PRIMARY_MODEL"
echo ""
echo "  3. Create a video:"
echo "     ~/ai-video-workflow.sh 'Your video topic'"
echo ""
echo "  4. Test setup:"
echo "     ~/test-ai-setup.sh"
echo ""
print_info "Next Steps:"
echo "  1. Download video models via ComfyUI Manager:"
echo "     - CogVideoX-5B (best quality)"
echo "     - LTX-Video (fast iteration)"
echo "     - AnimateDiff (lightweight)"
echo ""
echo "  2. Install MLX optimization:"
echo "     - Open ComfyUI → Manager → Search 'MLX' → Install"
echo ""
echo "  3. Download workflows:"
echo "     - https://comfyworkflows.com"
echo "     - https://civitai.com"
echo ""
print_info "Documentation:"
echo "  • ComfyUI Docs: https://docs.comfy.org"
echo "  • Ollama Docs: https://ollama.com/docs"
echo "  • Coqui TTS: https://github.com/coqui-ai/TTS"
echo "  • Piper TTS: https://github.com/rhasspy/piper"
echo ""
print_status "Setup complete! Enjoy your local AI video production!"
echo ""

# Mac M4 Pro — Local AI Video Production Pipeline

**100% Local. 100% Free. 100% Open Source.**

One script to set up a complete AI video production pipeline on your Mac — from script generation to final video with transitions. No cloud subscriptions, no API keys, no data leaving your machine.

## What It Does

Run one command and get a fully assembled video:

```bash
~/ai-video-workflow.sh "How to build AI apps on Mac M4 Pro"
```

The pipeline runs **5 automated steps:**

| Step | Tool | Output |
|------|------|--------|
| 1. Script | Ollama (qwen2.5:72b) | `script.txt` — narration-only text |
| 2. Shot List | Ollama | `shotlist.txt` — timestamped directions |
| 3. Voiceover | Coqui VITS (primary) / Piper TTS (fallback) | `voiceover.wav` — multi-speaker TTS |
| 4. Music | AudioCraft/MusicGen | `music.wav` — AI-generated background |
| 5. Video | build-video.py | `video.mp4` — slides + transitions + audio |

### Video Features
- **Topic-aware infographic slides** — dashboards, neural nets, flowcharts, code blocks, waveforms, timelines (auto-selected via LLM)
- **7 transition effects** — crossfade, slide, zoom, circle reveal, wipe, fade through black
- **Smoothstep easing** on all transitions
- **Proportional timing** — slide duration matches narration length
- **Author credit + progress bar + outro with repo link**

    - viz_config.json     (optional — auto-generated via Ollama if missing)

def load_fonts():
    sizes = {"font": 32, "title": 52, "small": 22, "label": 18, "icon": 14}
    fonts = {}
    for name, size in sizes.items():
        try:
            fonts[name] = ImageFont.truetype("/System/Library/Fonts/Helvetica.ttc", size)
        except (OSError, IOError):
            try:
                fonts[name] = ImageFont.truetype("/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans.ttf", size)
            except (OSError, IOError):
                fonts[name] = ImageFont.load_default()
    return fonts

def gradient(draw, w, h, c1, c2):
    for y in range(h):
        t = y / h
        r = int(c1[0] + (c2[0] - c1[0]) * t)
        g = int(c1[1] + (c2[1] - c1[1]) * t)
        b = int(c1[2] + (c2[2] - c1[2]) * t)
        draw.line([(0, y), (w, y)], fill=(r, g, b))

def dim(color, factor=0.4):
    return tuple(int(c * factor) for c in color)

def bright(color, factor=1.5):

# ─── Transition effects ─────────────────────────────────────

def crossfade(a, b, t):
    return Image.fromarray(
        (np.array(a, dtype=np.float32) * (1 - t) +
         np.array(b, dtype=np.float32) * t).astype(np.uint8))

def fade_black(a, b, t):
    if t < 0.5:
        return Image.fromarray((np.array(a, dtype=np.float32) * (1 - t * 2)).astype(np.uint8))
    return Image.fromarray((np.array(b, dtype=np.float32) * ((t - 0.5) * 2)).astype(np.uint8))

def slide_left(a, b, t):
    canvas = Image.new("RGB", (W, H))
    canvas.paste(a, (-int(W * t), 0))
    canvas.paste(b, (int(W * (1 - t)), 0))
    return canvas

def slide_right(a, b, t):
    canvas = Image.new("RGB", (W, H))
    canvas.paste(a, (int(W * t), 0))
    canvas.paste(b, (-int(W * (1 - t)), 0))
    return canvas

def wipe_down(a, b, t):
    canvas = a.copy()
    canvas.paste(b.crop((0, 0, W, int(H * t))), (0, 0))
    return canvas

def zoom_in(a, b, t):
    scale = 1.0 + t * 0.3
    cw, ch = int(W / scale), int(H / scale)
    x1, y1 = (W - cw) // 2, (H - ch) // 2
    zoomed = a.crop((x1, y1, x1 + cw, y1 + ch)).resize((W, H), Image.LANCZOS)
    return Image.fromarray(
        (np.array(zoomed, dtype=np.float32) * (1 - t) +
         np.array(b, dtype=np.float32) * t).astype(np.uint8))

def circle_reveal(a, b, t):
    mask = Image.new("L", (W, H), 0)
    d = ImageDraw.Draw(mask)
    r = int(math.sqrt(W ** 2 + H ** 2) / 2 * t)
    cx, cy = W // 2, H // 2
    d.ellipse([cx - r, cy - r, cx + r, cy + r], fill=255)
    mask = mask.filter(ImageFilter.GaussianBlur(radius=8))
    return Image.composite(b, a, mask)

TRANSITIONS = [
    crossfade, slide_left, zoom_in, fade_black,
    circle_reveal, wipe_down, slide_right, crossfade,
    zoom_in, fade_black,
]

# ─── Viz config generation ──────────────────────────────────

def generate_viz_config(paragraphs, output_dir):
    """Use Ollama to generate viz_config.json if not present."""
    config_path = os.path.join(output_dir, "viz_config.json")
    if os.path.exists(config_path):
        return json.load(open(config_path))

    print("  Generating visualization config via Ollama...")
    prompt = (
        "Analyze these video narration paragraphs. For each, return a JSON object.\n"
        "Return ONLY a JSON array, no other text. Exactly {n} elements.\n"
        'Each: {{"viz": "type", "keywords": ["k1","k2","k3"], "title": "Short Title"}}\n\n'
        "Types: pipeline_flow, network_graph, architecture, waveform, neural_net, "
        "code_block, shield, dashboard, video_editor, social_cta\n\n"
    ).format(n=len(paragraphs))

    for i, p in enumerate(paragraphs):
        prompt += f"Paragraph {i}: {p[:150]}...\n\n"

    try:
        result = subprocess.run(
            ["ollama", "run", "qwen2.5:72b", prompt],
            capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=300)
        output = result.stdout.strip()
        start, end = output.find("["), output.rfind("]") + 1
        if start >= 0 and end > start:
            data = json.loads(output[start:end])
            with open(config_path, "w") as f:
                json.dump(data, f, indent=2)
            return data
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"  Warning: Ollama failed ({e}), using default config")

    # Fallback: cycle through viz types
    types = list(VIZ_RENDERERS.keys())
    return [{"viz": types[i % len(types)], "keywords": [], "title": f"Section {i + 1}"}
            for i in range(len(paragraphs))]

    slides_dir = os.path.join(output_dir, "slides")

    elapsed = 0

    for i, para in enumerate(paragraphs):
        c_top, c_bot, accent = THEMES[i % len(THEMES)]
        viz = viz_config[i] if i < len(viz_config) else {"viz": "dashboard", "keywords": [], "title": ""}

        img = Image.new("RGB", (W, H), c_top)
        draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)
        gradient(draw, W, H, c_top, c_bot)

        # Visualization (strictly in left zone)
        viz_pad = 60
        viz_region = (viz_pad, 80, VIZ_RIGHT_EDGE - viz_pad * 2, H - 200)
        renderer = VIZ_RENDERERS.get(viz.get("viz", "dashboard"), draw_dashboard)
        random.seed(i * 17)
        renderer(draw, accent, viz.get("keywords", []), viz_region)

        # Divider
        draw.line([(DIVIDER_X, 50), (DIVIDER_X, H - 50)], fill=dim(accent, 0.3), width=1)

        text_start_y = 80
        if title:
            draw.text((TEXT_LEFT, 80), title, fill=accent, font=FONTS["small"])
            text_start_y = 120

        # Wrapped text (right column, vertically centered)
        avail_px = W - TEXT_LEFT - TEXT_RIGHT_PAD
        wrap_chars = max(20, avail_px // 17)
        lines = textwrap.fill(para, width=wrap_chars).split("\n")
        line_h = 38
        total_h = len(lines) * line_h
        y_start = max(text_start_y, (H - total_h) // 2)

        for j, line in enumerate(lines):
            y = y_start + j * line_h

                  fill=(80, 80, 90), font=FONTS["icon"])

        fname = os.path.join(slides_dir, f"slide_{i:03d}.png")
        img.save(fname)
        slides.append(img)
        elapsed += durations[i]
        print(f"  Slide {i}: [{viz.get('viz')}] {title}")

    # Outro slide
    img = Image.new("RGB", (W, H), THEMES[0][0])
    draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)
    gradient(draw, W, H, THEMES[0][0], THEMES[0][1])
    accent = THEMES[0][2]

    for text_str, y, f, color in [
        ("Thanks for Watching!", 200, FONTS["title"], accent),
        (f"Created by {AUTHOR}", 330, FONTS["small"], (220, 220, 230)),
        (REPO_URL, 420, FONTS["font"], accent),

        ("100% Local  •  100% Free  •  100% Open Source", 560, FONTS["small"], (160, 160, 170)),
    ]:
        bbox = draw.textbbox((0, 0), text_str, font=f)
        tw = bbox[2] - bbox[0]

    draw.line([(W // 2 - 250, 280), (W // 2 + 250, 280)], fill=accent, width=2)

    # CTA buttons

    btn_w, btn_h = 200, 55

                               outline=color, width=3, fill=dim(color, 0.15))
        bbox = draw.textbbox((0, 0), label, font=FONTS["label"])
        draw.text((bx + (btn_w - (bbox[2] - bbox[0])) // 2, by + 17), label,
                  fill=color, font=FONTS["label"])

    draw.rectangle([0, H - 6, W, H], fill=accent)
    fname = os.path.join(slides_dir, "slide_outro.png")
    img.save(fname)
    slides.append(img)

    return slides

# ─── Video assembly with transitions ────────────────────────

def assemble_video(slides, durations, output_dir, fps=FPS):
    trans_frames = int(TRANS_DURATION * fps)
    voiceover_path = os.path.join(output_dir, "voiceover.wav")
    music_path = os.path.join(output_dir, "music.wav")
    video_path = os.path.join(output_dir, "video.mp4")

    # Adjust durations for timing offset
    adj = list(durations)
    for i in range(len(adj)):
        if i > 0:
            adj[i] += TIMING_OFFSET
        if i < len(adj) - 1:
            adj[i] -= TIMING_OFFSET
        adj[i] = max(2.0, adj[i])

    total_frames = 0
    for i, d in enumerate(adj):
        hold = int(d * fps)
        if i < len(adj) - 1:
            hold -= trans_frames
        total_frames += max(1, hold)
        if i < len(adj) - 1:
            total_frames += trans_frames

    print(f"  Rendering {total_frames} frames ({total_frames / fps:.1f}s)...")

    ffmpeg_cmd = [
        "ffmpeg", "-y",
        "-f", "rawvideo", "-pix_fmt", "rgb24", "-s", f"{W}x{H}", "-r", str(fps),
        "-i", "pipe:0",
        "-i", voiceover_path,
        "-i", music_path,
        "-filter_complex",
        f"[2:a]volume={MUSIC_VOLUME}[bg];[1:a][bg]amix=inputs=2:duration=first[aout]",
        "-map", "0:v", "-map", "[aout]",
        "-c:v", "libx264", "-preset", "fast", "-crf", "23",
        "-pix_fmt", "yuv420p", "-shortest", video_path,
    ]

    proc = subprocess.Popen(ffmpeg_cmd, stdin=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
    frame_count = 0

    for i in range(len(slides)):
        hold = int(adj[i] * fps)
        if i < len(slides) - 1:
            hold -= trans_frames
        hold = max(1, hold)

        raw = np.array(slides[i]).tobytes()
        for _ in range(hold):
            proc.stdin.write(raw)
            frame_count += 1

        if i < len(slides) - 1:
            trans_fn = TRANSITIONS[i % len(TRANSITIONS)]
            for f in range(trans_frames):
                t = f / (trans_frames - 1)
                t = t * t * (3 - 2 * t)  # smoothstep easing
                frame = trans_fn(slides[i], slides[i + 1], t)
                proc.stdin.write(np.array(frame).tobytes())
                frame_count += 1

        if (i + 1) % 3 == 0 or i == len(slides) - 1:
            pct = int(frame_count / total_frames * 100)
            print(f"  Progress: {pct}% ({frame_count}/{total_frames} frames)")

    proc.stdin.close()
    proc.wait()
    size_mb = os.path.getsize(video_path) / 1024 / 1024
    print(f"  Output: {video_path} ({size_mb:.1f}MB)")
    return video_path

def main():
    global AUTHOR, REPO_URL
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="AI Video Assembler")
    parser.add_argument("output_dir", help="Directory with workflow assets")
    parser.add_argument("--fps", type=int, default=FPS, help=f"Frames per second (default: {FPS})")
    parser.add_argument("--author", default=AUTHOR, help=f"Author name (default: {AUTHOR})")
    parser.add_argument("--repo", default=REPO_URL, help=f"Repo URL (default: {REPO_URL})")
    args = parser.parse_args()

    AUTHOR = args.author
    REPO_URL = args.repo

    output_dir = os.path.abspath(args.output_dir)
    voiceover_text = os.path.join(output_dir, "voiceover_text.txt")
    voiceover_wav = os.path.join(output_dir, "voiceover.wav")
    music_wav = os.path.join(output_dir, "music.wav")

    for f in [voiceover_text, voiceover_wav, music_wav]:
        if not os.path.exists(f):
            print(f"Error: Missing {f}")
            sys.exit(1)

    print("AI Video Assembler")
    print("=" * 50)

    # Load text + durations
    text = open(voiceover_text).read().strip()
    paragraphs = [p.strip() for p in text.split("\n\n") if p.strip()]

    with wave.open(voiceover_wav, "r") as w:
        vo_duration = w.getnframes() / w.getframerate()
    print(f"  Paragraphs: {len(paragraphs)}, Voiceover: {vo_duration:.1f}s")

    total_chars = sum(len(p) for p in paragraphs)
    durations = [(len(p) / total_chars) * vo_duration for p in paragraphs]
    durations.append(OUTRO_DURATION)

    # Viz config
    print("\n[1/3] Visualization config...")
    viz_config = generate_viz_config(paragraphs, output_dir)

    # Slides
    print("\n[2/3] Generating slides...")
    slides = generate_slides(paragraphs, viz_config, durations, vo_duration, output_dir)

    # Video
    print("\n[3/3] Assembling video with transitions...")
    video_path = assemble_video(slides, durations, output_dir, args.fps)

    print("\n" + "=" * 50)
    print(f"  ✓ Video ready: {video_path}")
    print("=" * 50)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
